title: Service Test 97/98: Ice maker water fill

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Bella 32 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W10901168, WRF992/993/995)
source.oemTestTitle: Door Ice Maker Valve General Test

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Bella Diagnostics
steps.body: Diagnostics active. Use Up/Down to navigate; Icemaker2 to select test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Diagnostics active. Use Up/Down to navigate; Icemaker2 to select test.

steps.title: Select Service Test 97
steps.body: In Diagnostics (Recommended+Drawer hold 5 s), use Up/Down to test 97. Press Icemaker2 to select. Fast Cool backs out.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 97 — Door IM valve (or 98 freezer)

steps.title: Water fills tray
steps.body: Display on ~5 s then oFF. Water in door IM tray? Also runs isolation valve.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Display on ~5 s then oFF. Water in door IM tray? Also runs isolation valve.

steps.title: Fill tube heater
steps.body: Run test 66 (door) or 67 (freezer) — display on 15 min, re-test 97/98.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run test 66 (door) or 67 (freezer) — display on 15 min, re-test 97/98.

steps.title: Check valves & tubing
steps.oemOutcome: Isolation valve, IM valve, fill tube heater resistances.
